name: net_session_browser_dialog_do_data_exchange
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::DoDataExchange binds the multiplayer session-browser controls and validates the player-name CString. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The method is a provider-backed MFC DDX/DDV wrapper; the smoke verifies imported provider call order and arguments rather than running live dialog data exchange.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41af50 validates the provider call sequence: DDX_Control for control ids 1048, 1, 1030, 1040, and 1114 using offsets 0x70, 0xb0, 0xf0, 0x130, and 0x170, then DDX_Text for CString at 0x1b0 and DDV_MaxChars with limit 21.
Recoil.rc dialog 136 confirms the same player-name edit, Play/OK button, New Game button, session list, and provider combo control ids.
The native smoke patches the three MFC42 provider imports and verifies call order, control ids, the shared CDataExchange pointer, object addresses, and the 21-character player-name limit.
